platform: STMPD RCRDS Official SoundCloud Login Demo Drop Route
manual_review_reason: STMPD RCRDS links its official Demo Drop from the label homepage. The portal accepts original demo tracks only, explicitly excludes remixes and bootlegs, and requires connecting and logging in with SoundCloud under the portal terms and privacy policy. A human must approve account authorization, track ownership, original-work status, private-link permissions, metadata and all live declarations before submission.

platform: Selected Base Native Unreleased Streamable-Link Demo Drop Route
manual_review_reason: Selected Base states that it is constantly looking for new music to sign and accepts only streamable links to unreleased tracks, preferably via SoundCloud, YouTube, Dropbox or Google Drive. Its official imprint also publishes inbox@selectedbase.com specifically for demos. A human must choose the authorized form or published demo mailbox, verify unreleased and rights status, review link accessibility and privacy, complete all live fields and avoid follow-up chasing after submission.

platform: Future House Music Official Discord Demo Drop Route
manual_review_reason: Future House Music explicitly directs artists from its official site and contact page to a Discord demodrop and describes recurring demo drops and feedback events in its community. Discord membership, login, channel rules, posting permissions, rights, track format and any live moderation requirements must be reviewed by a person. The adjacent general contact form is not a substitute for the designated demo route.

platform: Spinnin Records Account-Gated Talent Pool Demo Upload Route
manual_review_reason: Spinnin' Records explicitly directs new talent to upload tracks through its Talent Pool and requires creating or logging into an account before a demo can be submitted. The public pool displays ranked and newly added tracks. A human must review account terms, public-visibility implications, upload format, rights, master and metadata, any contest or voting conditions and all live consent fields before using the service.

platform: Dim Mak Official Dynamic Demo Submission Page Route
manual_review_reason: Dim Mak exposes a dedicated Send Demos destination from its official navigation, but the statically accessible page does not expose the complete live form, upload or link requirements, declarations, consent language, limits or runtime verification state. A human must inspect the rendered demo workflow, confirm label fit, ownership, master status, metadata and all terms before entering data or delivering audio.
